products.name: Blue
products.description: The verification substrate every MOBLUEHQ product runs on. A private inference mesh that returns sealed, signed results - the scheduler never sees your data, and every answer carries a receipt anyone can verify.
products.description_after: The rail underneath the portfolio. For everyone building AI into decisions that carry consequences - the layer that proves how an answer was produced, not just that it sounds right.

products.name: slumberNet
products.description: The compute mesh we're building toward - pool a machine's spare capacity to help run verified AI work. Not a public download yet: today's build is internal and unsigned, run only on our own machines. Built on a simple bet: if enough machines pitch in,
products.description_after: This is the direction we're building toward, not what happens today. For anyone with a capable machine and spare capacity to share - the supply side that would let a verifiable mesh scale without hyperscaler lock-in.
products.stage_label: In development - internal build only, not yet available to install
products.description_bold: much of the AI work the world does will never need a giant data center built for it.
